mentions.name: Personal Common Crawl web indexer
mentions.description: A personal web indexer built for the owner's own use, using data from Common Crawl, which handles the crawling and hosts the resulting dataset.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on an indexer for myself using data from common crawl. They do all the leg work and just host the outcome.
